crossRefs.note: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.
He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.
God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.
Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

translations.web: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?
translations.bsb: can you, like Him, spread out the skies, as strong as a mirror of bronze?
translations.kjv: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?
translations.asv: Canst thou with him spread out the sky, Which is strong as a molten mirror?
